  P2 informational (CEX wallet, new wallet, no anomaly)

tool_signatures.description: Comprehensive email domain health check: MX routing, SPF authentication, DKIM signing, DMARC policy enforcement, DNSBL blacklist status (Spamhaus/SpamCop/Barracuda), TLS certificate validity, and WHOIS registration age. Cache: 1h forecast / 24h historical / 7d climate_risk.

tool_signatures.description: Manage HTTP webhook callbacks for async tools (T5/T6 batch flagships).
